Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. is a prominent chemical company strategically located at 102 Sudhan Apartment, Opposite Tejas School, Race Course, Baroda-7, in the vibrant city of Baroda, Gujarat, India. Renowned for its commitment to quality and innovation, Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. has established itself as a key player in the chemical industry, catering to a wide array of sectors with high-grade chemical products. The company prides itself on its state-of-the-art manufacturing processes, stringent quality control measures, and adherence to environmental and safety standards, ensuring that every product delivered meets the highest standards of excellence.

Situated in Baroda, a major industrial hub in Gujarat, Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. leverages the region’s robust infrastructure, skilled workforce, and advanced logistical networks to serve both domestic and international markets efficiently. The company specializes in the production and distribution of various acids and chemical compounds, making it an indispensable partner for industries such as pharmaceuticals, textiles, agriculture, and manufacturing. With a dedicated team of professionals and continuous investment in research and development, Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. aims to innovate sustainable chemical solutions that drive industrial growth while minimizing environmental impact.

Committed to customer satisfaction, safety, and sustainable practices, Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. is not only a supplier but a trusted collaborator to businesses seeking reliability, quality, and cutting-edge chemical products in Gujarat and beyond.
